criterion_scores.reasoning: The overall sweep structure matches the spec, but the row-append command is malformed and threatens the core behavior: logging abandoned rows. I checked the live-claim gate, stale threshold, per-session filtering, and SessionEnd branch, but the jq append path at lines 61-63 is broken.

The requested pieces are present: SessionStart sweep, stale pending-row scan, once-only logging, SessionEnd mode, and a user-facing summary. The only notable issue I found is in correctness of the append command, not missing functionality.

The file placement and hook style are plausible for this build artifact, and I did not find a house-convention violation such as a wrong skill prefix or a bypassed write path. The script also keeps the output format plain-text as advertised.

The artifact stays focused on the gate-sweep task and does not introduce obvious over-engineering, duplicate state, or tombstoned tooling. The only caution is the extra SessionEnd mode in the same script, but that is aligned with the spec rather than speculative sprawl.

The script has helpful comments and a visible summary block, but the header overstates verification of SessionEnd support without evidence in the artifact. That is a minor honesty/narration issue, not a functional one.

defects.quote: '{event:$ev_name, session:$s, ts:$t, pending:1, corrupt:0, events:$ev, ledger:$src}' --arg ev_name "$ev_name" \
defects.spec_ref: Fix 1 — abandoned-run half: “logs each once as `*_gate_abandoned`”
defects.description: The jq invocation puts `--arg ev_name` after the program text, so jq will not receive the variable binding correctly (it will be parsed as a filename / leave `$ev_name` undefined). That breaks the append path for abandoned-row telemetry, so the sweep may fail to log the rows it is supposed to record.
